newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton output reaches 5.6 mln bales.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton output reaches 5.6 mln bales.

text.p: Pakistan's cotton output had reached 5.606 million 375-lb bales by December 1, a three percent increase over the 5.431 million bales produced by the same time last year, ginners said on Thursday.

The private Pakistan Cotton Ginners Association, giving its bi-monthly figures for production in the 1996/97 (July-June) crop year, said spinning mills had bought 4.028 million bales, against 3.544 million at the same date last year.

Exporters had bought 2,500 bales, compared to 355,495 last year, it said. Ginneries had unsold stocks of 815,000 bales and 760,000 unginned press bales on December 1, compared to total stocks of 1.532 million bales a year earlier. --Karachi newsroom 9221-5685192.
